H1 > H2 > H3 creates three levels of heading nesting

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Top Level</h1><p>Top intro.</p><h2>Mid Level</h2><p>Mid content.</p><h3>Deep Level</h3><p>Deep content.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
debugPrint(result.document?.nodes as Any)
```
